views.note: The twins corner is by the north window in this room. Existing floor plan has one door. Bedside lamps rise above low nightstands; king-bed native canvas is 184x240.
One existing door; narrow shelf keeps the whole doorway reachable.
One existing door; 96px approach reaches open floor in front of hanging clothes.
The tub shampoo row and tank plant are painted with their fixtures. Existing bathroom has one door.

Existing hall is 144px wide, so it cannot meet the 224px main-route target. Kept entirely clear for every actual opening. North master opening overlaps hall by 104px, leaving too little north wall for a frame; the painted edge-on frame hangs on the solid east-wall stretch.
Painted carpeted stair flight and landings. Stair treads are walkable ground art; the east landing opens onto the hall.
One existing door. Heater footprint stays west, 96px access square fits east.
Hoop, net and medals hang on north bifold doors. One existing door opens on the east side.

Two connected exits: north hall and west closet. North wall displays stay to the right of the hall doorway. East TV and rear-view south dresser are painted for those angles. No plate: the newer upstairs privacy rule supersedes MIDLIFE plate request. No real faces.
